name: Rep Session
summary: Track the reputation you earn this session, your reputation per hour and how long until the next standing with your watched faction.
logoPrompt: A small brass hourglass standing upright in the centre, its falling sand glowing gold, with a silk ribbon banner wrapped around its middle

cover.tagline: Know when the next standing arrives.

description: **Rep Session watches the faction on your reputation bar and tells you how fast you are earning with it and when you reach the next standing.**
- Reputation gained this session with your watched faction.
- Reputation per hour and the estimated time until the next standing.
- Regular, renown and friendship factions, counted correctly across a new standing or renown level.
- Each faction keeps its own count, so switching the watched faction loses nothing.
Watch a faction in the reputation panel. Type `/rs` (or `/repsession`) to see the numbers in chat, `/rs show` for a small window and `/rs reset` to start over.
- Works on Retail. No combat data and no chat parsing.
- The rate and the time appear after five minutes, so a single quest reward does not distort them.
- At the highest standing it shows max. Paragon rewards are not counted.
- A session starts at login or after a reload.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
